Pose GUARD: stable slightly bent knees, one boot a little forward, polymer shield raised defensively in front of his chest, baton held low and ready in his other hand, head looking left at an opponent. Entire person, both boots, all antenna tips, shield, cargo frame and baton must fit inside a square 1536 by 1536 transparent canvas with at least 10 percent fully transparent margin on every side. Remove the reference's black and gray photographic background and every surrounding gray halo completely. The entire area outside the person and equipment is fully transparent RGBA, including gaps between limbs and equipment. Clean antialiased silhouette, no glow, no ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no background vignette, no fog, no colored edge fringe. Exactly one character in one pose. No text, logo, UI, duplicate panels or scenery.

Cleanup pass: Production cleanup of the attached game sprite. Preserve the exact same single older male porter character, left-facing defensive guard pose, face, hood, graphite/mustard outfit, all straps, cargo case, antenna, shield, baton, boots and realistic texture. Do not redesign anything. Place the entire unchanged figure smaller at the center of a square canvas: its highest antenna tip and its lowest boot must BOTH have at least 130 pixels of completely transparent clearance in a 1280 by 1280 canvas. Fit the complete silhouette inside the central 80 percent of the image. Clean every silhouette edge, especially the left thigh, boots and antenna: remove every red/orange stray fringe pixel, all colored edge contamination, gray halo and any outside haze. Keep only the physical character and equipment. Fully transparent RGBA background and transparent gaps, no ground, no floor shadow, no glow. One clean isolated character sprite, no lettering. All original physical accessories must remain fully visible.
